description: Expose Qantara's active browser voice session as an MCP server
notes: Open Qantara in a browser first so there is an active voice session.
Use voice_get_status to find session_id or client_session_id when multiple browsers are connected.
For streamable HTTP, set QANTARA_MCP_SERVER_TRANSPORT=streamable-http and QANTARA_MCP_SERVER_PORT=8766.
